head: codex/121-quorum-fence-restart-safe-epochs
title: [v0.92][WP-04.07][defect] Support quorum fencing and restart-safe lease epochs
body:
Closes #121

## Summary
- makes activation-key possession operation-sensitive so a committed quorum can Fence or Revoke an unavailable holder
- commits Fence at exactly the next epoch and newer applied index while preserving the old signed portable recovery floor
- restores durable fenced state at the current committed membership index and removes the floor only after delayed valid activation
- keeps invalid epoch, holder, replay, capacity, and snapshot transitions atomic and fail closed

## Validation
- exact focused nextest: 20 passed, 0 skipped
- strict focused Clippy: passed
- 11 machine-derived negative cases: passed with exact command, status, denominator, digest, and marker parity
- producer command/status tamper contract: passed
- producer and verifier symlink/path-safety contract: passed
- final V3 receipt: passed, binding source eeedb493dfa456e32c83130356db703487602a40 to evidence 16c46300900f8a408f36cd04500c3f45d1e9e948
- stacked git diff check: passed

## Review
- independent exact-head correctness/security review approved aaf7e32f743c783b3d70dc028402723093b02ed8 with zero actionable findings
- the current head adds typed review metadata only

## Stack
- targets `codex/5909-lease-authority-defect` while parent PR #120 remains open
- no `fencing.rs`, registration, Cargo, or sibling distributed paths are changed
- no merge is performed by this publication
